messages.author: 5c66aacafcc027ee
messages.subject: EzPlot2 y-axis range
parts:
Hi, how can I change the range of the y-axis using EzPlot2 in R? I can't find an example online anywhere. I tried setting y_free=TRUE and using ylim(ymin, ymax) and other code, but none of it works. Any help would be appreciated.

Vicki

messages.author: dae01c57a3c54a3a
messages.subject: Re: [ez4r] EzPlot2 y-axis range
parts:
ezPlot/ezPlot2 generate ggplot2 objects, so you can use ggplot2's scale_y_continuous() function, as in:

my_plot = ezPlot2(...)

my_plot + scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-1,1))



Cheers,

Mike
